ps/MIDASCORE/MIDASCORE_BP_I_004.jpg.text: 你的武器在镀金肌理间不断刻下落脚点，犹如一位狂神，正亲手雕凿出登天的黄金阶梯。
ps/MIDASCORE/MIDASCORE_BP_I_004.jpg.en: Critical: Your weapon finds purchase in the aurified skin, again and again, as if you were carving a golden staircase.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_II_005.jpg.text: 获得等同于命中次数的绝望指示物

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_II_005.jpg.text: 获得 1 枚神浆指示物。

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_II_006.jpg.text: 获得 1 枚神浆指示物。

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_001.jpg.text: 击倒。获得「大恐怖」状态卡。每次命中造成 5 危险。获得 1 枚神浆指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_001.jpg.en: [!] Move Lateral & Attack: [Fate] 6+: +1 [Evasion Die]. Knockdown. Gain the Holy Terror Condition card. Each hit deals 5 [Danger]. Gain 1 Ambrosia token.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_002.jpg.text: 障碍不会阻挡本次攻击。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_002.jpg.en: Obstacles do not block this Attack.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_002.jpg.text: 获得「恐怖」状态卡。燃烧。每次命中造成 4 危险和 1 枚绝望指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_002.jpg.en: [!] Move Lateral & Attack: Gain the Terror Condition card. Burn. Each hit deals 4 [Danger] and 1 Despair token.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_002.jpg.text: 在攻击路径上紧邻攻击来源处放置一块 1×5 海沟地形板块。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_002.jpg.en: [!] After Attack: Place a 1x5 Trench Terrain tile adjacent to the source of the Attack, in the path of the Attack.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_003.jpg.text: 燃烧。击倒。每次命中造成 5 危险。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_003.jpg.en: [!] Move Lateral & Attack: [Fate] 6+: +1 [Evasion Die]. Burn. Knockdown. Each hit deals 5 [Danger].

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_003.jpg.text: 获得「恐怖」状态卡，并获得等同于命中次数的神浆指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_003.jpg.en: After Attack: Gain the Terror Condition card and as many Ambrosia tokens as there were hits.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_004.jpg.text: 弃置 1 枚氧气指示物
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_004.jpg.en: [!] Attack: [Fate] 6+: Discard 1 Oxygen token. Gain the Terror Condition card. Burn. Each hit deals 4 [Danger].

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_004.jpg.text: 获得「恐怖」状态卡。燃烧。每次命中造成 4 危险。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_004.jpg.en: [!] Attack: [Fate] 6+: Discard 1 Oxygen token. Gain the Terror Condition card. Burn. Each hit deals 4 [Danger].

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_005.jpg.text: 获得 2 枚神浆指示物。每次命中造成 2 危险。获得「麻痹」状态卡。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_005.jpg.en: [!] Move Lateral & Attack: Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. Each hit deals 2 [Danger]. Gain the Paralyzed Condition card.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_005.jpg.text: 若造成了危险，对另一目标重复本次攻击一次。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_005.jpg.en: [!] After Attack: If [Danger] was dealt, repeat this Attack against another Target (once).

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_006.jpg.text: 燃烧。每次命中造成 3 危险。然后，若与一块石化烟囱地形板块相邻，获得 5 枚神浆指示物，并移除该烟囱。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_006.jpg.en: [!] Attack: Burn. Each hit deals 3 [Danger]. Then, if adjacent to a Petrified Vent Terrain tile, gain 5 Ambrosia tokens and remove that Vent. [Fate] 4+: Gain as many Despair tokens as there are hits.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_006.jpg.text: 获得等同于命中次数的
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_006.jpg.en: [!] Attack: Burn. Each hit deals 3 [Danger]. Then, if adjacent to a Petrified Vent Terrain tile, gain 5 Ambrosia tokens and remove that Vent. [Fate] 4+: Gain as many Despair tokens as there are hits.
[!] Attack: Burn. Each hit deals 3 [Danger]. Then, if adjacent to a Petrified Vent Terrain tile, gain 5 Ambrosia tokens and remove that Vent. [Fate] 4+: Gain as many Despair tokens as there are hits.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_006.jpg.text: 下一次扫描的难度提高 X，X 为始徒等级。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_AI_III_006.jpg.en: After Final Attack: Raise the difficulty of the next Scan by X, where X is the Primordial level.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_001.jpg.text: 纵然被齐根斩断，那残肢亦如阴毒蝮蛇般蜿蜒扭动，妄图自你这死神脚下仓惶逃逸！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_001.jpg.en: Critical: It still writhes after you have cut it, tries to get away from you, sidewinding like a snake!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_001.jpg.text: 创建一个攀爬点。执行一次额外攻击！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_001.jpg.en: Create a VP. Perform a Bonus Attack!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_002.jpg.text: 燃烧。获得 1 枚绝望指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_002.jpg.en: Fail: Burn. Gain 1 Despair token. [!] Retreat 4.
Fail: Burn. Gain 1 Despair token. [!] Retreat 4.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_002.jpg.text: 获得 1 枚神浆指示物。
你挥剑斩断其一扇巨型魔鳍，怪物瞬间失去平衡肚皮翻白，将最致命的软肋彻底裸露于你的连环绝杀之前！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_002.jpg.en: Critical: You cut away one of the large fins, and the monster goes belly up, exposing itself for a follow-up!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_003.jpg.text: 获得 1 枚神浆指示物。
那形似竹节的附肢绝非为厮杀而生，仅是供这蟑螂般下贱的活物仓皇溃逃。但此时此刻，它已插翅难飞！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_003.jpg.en: Critical: A spindly appendage, not for fighting but for scurrying away, the cockroach that it is. No more!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_004.jpg.text: 获得 1 枚神浆指示物。
始徒身侧违逆法则的神浆云霾中，密集蠕动着虾蛆般的阴湿活物。你唤起燎原业火，将这污秽之海焚作了虚无！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_004.jpg.en: Critical: The ambrosia cloud that follows the Primordial is unnatural, swarming with tiny shrimp-like creatures. You set it aflame!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_005.jpg.en: Fail: Burn. Gain the Fear Condition card.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_005.jpg.text: 厚重皮囊之孔贪婪饱吸以太。你附有神威的一击提前引燃源力，直接在其五脏六腑中掀起连环殉爆！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_005.jpg.en: Critical: The pores of its thick hide are full of captured aether. Your blow ignites them prematurely, causing internal explosions!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_005.jpg.text: 获得「面纱包裹」装备卡（秘密卡组 18，第 286 张）！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_005.jpg.en: Gain the Veilwrappings [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 286)!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_006.jpg.text: 创建一个攀爬点。获得 1 枚绝望指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_006.jpg.en: Wound: Create a VP. Gain 1 Despair token.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_006.jpg.text: 那形似肿胀下腹的触须在神锋前竟柔弱如纸！断肢如丑陋海虫般漂浮蠕动，呕出浑浊神浆与泛白的刺鼻粘液。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_006.jpg.en: Critical: These udder-like tentacles are soft to the blade! Once cut, they float and squirm like sea worms, exuding ambrosia and another, milky substance.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_006.jpg.text: 创建一个攀爬点。获得「英勇」状态卡。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_I_006.jpg.en: Create a VP. Gain the Bravery Condition card.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_001.jpg.text: 燃烧。获得 1 枚神浆指示物。击倒。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_001.jpg.en: Fail: Burn. Gain 1 Ambrosia token. Knockdown.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_001.jpg.text: 此肺腑吞吐以太，却咳出焚城微波。便让这妖孽在无尽的呛咳中溺亡吧！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_001.jpg.en: Critical: These lungs breathe in aether and breathe out microwave fire. Let the thing cough itself to death!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_002.jpg.text: 你碾碎了主宰烈焰日冕的咒毒腺体，那曾是始徒步步紧逼时，用来笼罩一切的灭世业火源泉。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_002.jpg.en: Critical: You smash the glands responsible for the flaming corona that engulfs the Primordial whenever it bears down on you.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 翻转 1 枚氧气指示物。击倒。
弃置 1 枚以太指示物。获得 2 枚神浆指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Wound: Discard 1 Aether token. Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. [!] Retreat 5.
Wound: Discard 1 Aether token. Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. [!] Retreat 5.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 这肉管宛若深渊海底的恶魔烟囱，而喷涌的重浊瘴气内，更蛰伏着异界的嗜血寄生虫与纯粹的死亡。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Critical: These ducts resemble the black smoke vents found on the seafloor, but thicker fumes hide otherworldly parasites, and death.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 翻转 1 枚以太指示物。获得「微波护盾鳞片」装备卡
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Flip 1 Aether token. Gain the Microwave Shieldscale [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 287)!
Flip 1 Aether token. Gain the Microwave Shieldscale [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 287)!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_004.jpg.text: 燃烧。获得 1 枚神浆指示物和 1 枚以太指示物。击倒。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_004.jpg.en: Fail: Burn. Gain 1 Ambrosia token and 1 Aether token. Knockdown.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_004.jpg.text: 你雷霆般的重击彻底焊死了巨兽吞吐以太源力的所有幽微气孔！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_004.jpg.en: Critical: Your hit clogs the tiny hole the monster uses to regulate its aether intake!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_004.jpg.text: 创建一个攀爬点。执行一次额外攻击！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_004.jpg.en: Create a VP. Perform a Bonus Attack!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 获得 X 枚绝望指示物，X 为始徒等级。击倒。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_005.jpg.en: Fail: Gain X Despair tokens, where X is the Primordial level. Knockdown.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 获得 2 枚神浆指示物。
当这始徒张开血盆大口，你以碎骨钝击迎头痛砸，令其獠牙尽碎，并生生将残渣捅入它的咽喉。给老子咽碎骨吧！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_005.jpg.en: Critical: As the Primordial snaps at you, you meet it halfway with a blunt strike that shatters its teeth and sends the splinters deep into its throat. Choke on it!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_006.jpg.text: 苍白肉球中孵化着数以万计的恶魔虫卵。你誓燃灭世怒焰，绝不容许哪怕一只秽物苟活于世！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_II_006.jpg.en: Critical: These milk-white globules are the eggs of a thousand monstrosities. You will not let even one escape your wrath!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 燃烧。获得 2 枚神浆指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Fail: Burn. Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. [!] Skitter 5.
Fail: Burn. Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. [!] Skitter 5.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 抽取并结算一张 AI 卡。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Wound: Draw and perform an AI card.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 它虽双目失明，却散发着冰冷而无尽的追猎凶光，引诱千军万马蜂拥而至……将其连根剜出！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Critical: It does not see, but it beams a cold, hounding light for the others... Pull it out!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 从战斗版图外发起的攻击
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Attacks from outside of the Battle Board don't lose [!].
Attacks from outside of the Battle Board don't lose [!].

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 你可以在强度投掷前主动结束此次攻击。若如此做，清空协力池。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_002.jpg.en: You may voluntarily end this Attack before performing a Power Roll. If you do, clear the Kratos Pool.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 在深渊皮革的层层沟壑里，你窥见了不可名状的恐怖畸变体，仅一眼便令你的灵魂尖叫退缩。你咬碎牙关凭残存意志将它捣成烂泥。那究竟是何等亵渎之物？
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_002.jpg.en: Critical: Within the folds of the thick skin, you find something... alien and horrid, the mere visage of which triggers your flight response. With the last shreds of will, you manage to squash it. What was that?

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 获得「大恐怖」状态卡，并获得等同于你持有的以太指示物数量的绝望指示物。击倒。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Fail: Gain the Holy Terror Condition card and as many Despair tokens as you have Aether tokens. Knockdown.
Wound: Gain the Terror Condition card. Knockdown.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 这枚诡异腺体呈现出违逆常理的妖异对称，正低吟着超越凡尘的死亡挽歌——直至被你乱刃分尸。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Critical: Eerily symmetrical, this gland plays an otherworldly dirge – until you hack it to pieces.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 弃置所有「恐慌」「恐惧」「恐怖」和「大恐怖」状态卡。禁用获得这些状态卡的效果。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Discard all Fear, Dread, Terror, and Holy Terror Condition cards. Disable gaining those Condition cards.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_004.jpg.text: 燃烧。获得 3 枚神浆指示物。
在这宛若九幽地穴的脏腑内，微波烈焰狂暴激荡。化作引爆血肉的凡世催化剂，赐予它一场撕心裂肺的消化崩坏吧！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_004.jpg.en: Critical: Within this cavernous organ microwaves blossom. Become a mortal catalyst and give it the mother of all indigestions!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_005.jpg.text: 获得 2 枚神浆指示物。
妖兽冠以此名，那由蠕动眼柄交织而成的亵渎王冠，能令怒海沸腾燃烬。如英雄珀耳修斯那般，斩落并征服它吧！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_005.jpg.en: Critical: From which the monster takes its name, the writhing crown of eye-stalks that makes the seas burn. Become like Perseus, and wear it!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_005.jpg.text: 获得「透镜头灯」装备卡（秘密卡组 18，第 285 张）！
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_005.jpg.en: Gain the Oculus Headlamp [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 285)!

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 对攻击者执行标志行为。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_006.jpg.en: Instinct: Perform Signature against the Attacker.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 在肉山血海的极深处，隐藏着一块异象虚空，其轮廓竟如神话中流淌金血的圣羊，克律索马罗斯。这等神迹为何堕落于此？
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_006.jpg.en: Critical: Deep within the mountain of fat and muscles, a curious void remains, shaped like the fabled Chrysomallos, the divine ram of the Golden People. Why here, of all places?

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 须目刻托斯死亡！战斗结束后，结算「克律索马洛斯」特殊事件。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_BP_III_006.jpg.en: The Meduketos dies! After the Battle, resolve the Chrysomallos Special Event.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_ROUTINE_X_001.jpg.text: 每架泰坦弃置 1 枚氧气指示物，受到燃烧，并获得 1 枚神浆指示物。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_ROUTINE_X_001.jpg.en: Each Titan discards 1 Oxygen token, suffers Burn, and gains 1 Ambrosia token.

ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_SIGNATURE_X_001.j.text: 获得「恐慌」状态卡。每次命中造成 3 危险。
ps/MEDUKETOS/MEDUKETOS_SIGNATURE_X_001.j.en: [!] Move Lateral & Attack: [Fate] 8+: +1 [Evasion Die]. Gain the Fear Condition card. Each hit deals 3 [Danger].
[!] After Attack: Three or more hits, Burn.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_AI_O_001.jpg.text: 一架随机泰坦获得「恐慌」状态卡，另一架随机泰坦获得「恐怖」状态卡，第三架随机泰坦获得 2 枚绝望指示物。然后晋升 1，跳过此卡。此卡永不晋升。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_AI_O_001.jpg.en: Judge: A random Titan gains the Fear Condition card. Another random Titan gains the Terror Condition card. Third random Titan gains 2 Despair tokens. Then, escalate 1 (not this card). This card never escalates.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_AI_O_001.jpg.text: 结束始徒轮，并从卡组移除此卡。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_AI_O_001.jpg.en: After Attack: End the Primordial Round and remove this card from the deck.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_AI_I_001.jpg.text: 获得 1 枚绝望指示物。
每次命中造成 3 危险。燃烧。

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_I_006.jpg.text: 获得 1 枚绝望指示物。暗隐。
何其陌生，又如噩梦般熟悉，那杂糅着你的神祇、暴君与生父面貌的头颅，正死死凝视着你。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_I_006.jpg.en: Critical: So alien yet so familiar, the face of your god, your king, your father looks upon thee.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_I_006.jpg.text: 立刻弃置所有神浆指示物。

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_001.jpg.text: 燃烧。获得 2 枚神浆指示物。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_001.jpg.en: Fail: Burn. Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_001.jpg.text: 获得 2 枚以太指示物。暗隐。
万物生灵终将被渊薮吞噬。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_001.jpg.en: Critical: To Dark Do We At Last Return.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_001.jpg.text: 获得「深海头饰」装备卡（秘密卡组 18，第 293 张）！若已拥有，改为获得稀有资源「海王纹章」。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_001.jpg.en: Gain the Headdress of the Deep [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 293)! If you already have it, gain the Sea King's Crest Rare resource instead.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.text: 燃烧。每架泰坦获得 1 枚绝望指示物，然后受到乌尔-击退 4。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.en: Fail: Burn. Each Titan gains 1 Despair token, then suffers Ur-Knockback 4.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.text: 获得「大恐怖」状态卡。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.en: Wound: Gain the Holy Terror Condition card. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.text: 在那双眼眸深处你窥见了纯粹绝望，虽有神圣光辉流转，却因曾直视深渊而刻满惊惧。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.en: Critical: In those eyes you find despair, for despite their divine gleam they have seen fear.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.text: 从本场战斗的硬币卡组中只保留 1 张「你活下来了！」和 1 张「你死了」硬币卡，立即移除其余牌。然后执行一次额外攻击！
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_002.jpg.en: Immediately remove from Battle all cards from the Obol deck except 1 You live! and 1 You died Obol card. Then, perform a Bonus Attack!

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Fail: Gain the Holy Terror Condition card.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 禁用「只是一段回忆」特质。获得 1 枚以太指示物。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Wound: Disable the Just a Memory Trait. Gain 1 Aether token. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 这在你利刃下如枯叶剥落的干瘪空壳，究竟是何方神圣？在它异变成……这般修罗模样之前，又曾拥有怎样的宿命？
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Critical: What is this shriveled form that falls away at your blade? What was this thing before it became... this?

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.text: 你可以在强度投掷前主动结束此次攻击。若如此做，清空协力池。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.en: You may voluntarily end this Attack before performing a Power Roll. If you do, clear the Kratos Pool.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.text: 获得 2 枚神浆指示物。暗现。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.en: Fail: Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. Fade In.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.text: 获得 3 枚神浆指示物。暗隐。
那曾献祭于伟大洋神的骇兽焦皮，昔为永恒神恩的契约，今却沦为耻辱末路的丧钟。这片金羊毛；究竟何种色泽，早已无足轻重。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.en: Critical: The charred hide of some eldritch beast sacrificed to the great god of the seas, once a covenant of everlasting grace, today a promise of an ignoble end. The Fleece; its color is immaterial.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.text: 永久获得「染黑」：每场战斗开始时，获得 1 枚神浆指示物，并将你的觉醒范围提高至 9–10（每位阿尔戈英雄一生限一次）。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_004.jpg.en: Permanently gain Tainted: Gain 1 Ambrosia token at the start of each Battle and increase your Awakening Range to 9–10 (once per Argonaut Lifetime).

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 获得 2 枚神浆指示物。乌尔-击退 6。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_005.jpg.en: Wound: Gain 2 Ambrosia tokens. Ur-Knockback 6. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 太古巨兽之魔鳍，缠绕着光阴的恶毒与腐朽，已沦为乌尔-弗里斯不可分割的血肉，如日月经天般宣告着绝望降临。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_005.jpg.en: Critical: The fin of some primeval monster wreathed in time's decay and malice, an inseparable part of Ur-Fleece now, inevitable as the Sun, the Moon, and the stars.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 禁用「乌尔-击退 X」关键词。

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_006.jpg.text: 燃烧。翻转 1 枚氧气指示物。乌尔-击退 6。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_006.jpg.en: Instinct: Burn. Flip 1 Oxygen token. Ur-Knockback 6. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_006.jpg.text: 那燃烧的极恶烈火，是尼采口中超人渴求却未能驾驭的毁灭神炎。这，才是那陨落暴君配得上的真正王冠。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_006.jpg.en: Critical: It burns with a baleful fire, one that the Nietzschean tried and failed to imitate. This is a true crown for a dead king.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_II_006.jpg.text: 禁用「乌尔-拉近 X」关键词。

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 获得 3 枚神浆指示物。黑暗进军。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Fail: Gain 3 Ambrosia tokens. Black March.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 获得「恐惧」和「大恐怖」状态卡。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Wound: Gain Dread and Holy Terror Condition cards. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 那隐秘的‘彼端’，乃众神仅曾惊鸿一瞥便妄图僭越支配的禁区，最终却正是它，将诸神璀璨的神纪化作了漆黑寒灰。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Critical: Of that Other Place, which the gods glimpsed, which the gods sought to domineer, and which turned their age to blackened ash.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 你可以在强度投掷前主动结束此次攻击。若如此做，清空协力池。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_002.jpg.en: You may voluntarily end this Attack before performing a Power Roll. If you do, clear the Kratos Pool.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 随机获得一种恐惧症苦痛，并死亡。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_002.jpg.en: Instinct: Gain a random Phobia Affliction and die. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 乌尔-弗里斯的吞天巨躯内隐匿着一处超因果法域，那是供奉无上主宰的神魔祭坛，连祂亦在此俯首称臣。那是，纯粹筑予无上恐惧的喋血神殿。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_002.jpg.en: Critical: Within the vast body of Ur-Fleece, a paracausal place, a temple to a being of a higher order before which even He bowed in the end. A temple to fear.
Disable Fear, Dread, Terror, and Holy Terror Condition cards.
Disable Fear, Dread, Terror, and Holy Terror Condition cards.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 禁用「只是一段回忆」特质。获得 2 枚以太指示物。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Instinct: Disable the Just a Memory Trait. Gain 2 Aether tokens. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 究竟何种妖力，竟能侵蚀这世界之骨，令全能的奥林匹斯神明堕落？亦或……这些高高在上的幻影，从一开始便不曾存在……？
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Critical: What is this power that corrupts even the pillars of the world, the almighty Olympians? Or... where they never that to begin with...?

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_004.jpg.text: 燃烧。获得 3 枚神浆指示物。
获得 2 枚以太指示物。暗隐。
凡被乌尔-弗里斯吞没的神芒，皆坠入这无底幽腹中溃烂瓦解，一如那旧日诸神亦曾被自身的贪欲与疯狂反噬殆尽……
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_004.jpg.en: Critical: Into this bottomless belly has all light Ur-Fleece devoured been cast down to rot and fade, just like the gods were once devoured themselves...

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_004.jpg.text: 每架泰坦获得 1 枚氧气指示物和 2 枚以太指示物。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_004.jpg.en: Each Titan gains 1 Oxygen token and 2 Aether tokens.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_005.jpg.text: 禁用「只是一段回忆」特质。然后，对每架泰坦执行乌尔-拉近 3。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_005.jpg.en: Instinct: Disable the Just a Memory Trait. Then, Ur-Pull 3 each Titan. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_005.jpg.text: 乌尔-弗里斯的如山魔躯内潜藏着一处暗渊，那是更磅礴浩劫的余震。此创痕不系于凡胎，却深深刻录于岁月、生死与太虚之间。神浆正自其间泣血喷涌。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_005.jpg.en: Critical: Within the vast body of Ur-Fleece is a wound, an echo of larger one still, not in flesh, but in space and time, and life, and death, and void. It seeps ambrosia.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_005.jpg.text: 禁用「黑暗进军」关键词。结算「裂口」特殊事件。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_005.jpg.en: Disable the Black March keyword. Resolve The Tear Special Event.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 抽取并结算一张 AI 卡。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.en: Fail: Draw and perform an AI card.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 命运 +4。抽一张劫数卡。暗隐。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.en: Wound: Gain +4 [Fate]. Draw a Moiros card. Flicker.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 究竟需何等诡秘法则织就的因果之线，方能困死一尊古老全知，甚至亲手雕琢世界的创世神魂？
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.en: Critical: What strings could bind the soul of an ancient, omniscient being, a god who creates worlds?

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 每架泰坦将自己的命运重置为 0，阿尔戈号命运也重置为 0。获得「弦线」装备卡（秘密卡组 18，第 292 张）！
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_BP_III_006.jpg.en: Each Titan resets their [Fate] to 0, reset [Argo Fate] to 0. Gain the Strungstring [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 292)!

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_ROUTINE_X_001.jpg.en: Lose -1 [Hull]. Move Ur-Fleece 6 spaces on the Abyss Track.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_ROUTINE_X_001.jpg.text: 将乌尔-弗里斯在深渊轨上移动 6 格。
ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_ROUTINE_X_001.jpg.en: Lose -1 [Hull]. Move Ur-Fleece 6 spaces on the Abyss Track.

ps/UR_FLEECE/UR_FLEECE_ROUTINE_X_001_BAC.en: All Titans gain the Terror Condition card.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_AI_III_006.jpg.en: [!] Flash Step & Attack: Crit Evade Fail: Pacify, then Pacify. One hit, raise [Danger] to 9; two hits, raise [Danger] to 9 and draw an Obol; three or more hits, you die.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_AI_III_006.jpg.text: 若目标已经死亡，重复此 AI。

[!] After Final Attack: If the Target is dead, repeat this AI. Otherwise, Pushback 9.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_002.jpg.text: 重击轰然震碎了外部钢盔，令那尊泰坦步履踉跄。然而在破碎的冷硬装甲之下……竟蛰伏着另一副更令人毛骨悚然的血肉面具。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_002.jpg.en: Critical: The hit to the head shatters the exohelm and makes the Titan stumble. Beneath the armor... there is another, more organic faceplate.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_002.jpg.text: 将泰坦 X 向正后方移动 3 格，然后你向前移动 3 格，保持相邻。获得「伊阿珀托斯头盔」装备卡（秘密卡组 18，第 290 张）！若已拥有，改为获得稀有资源「黑面具」。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_002.jpg.en: Move Titan X 3 spaces directly backwards, then move 3 spaces forward to remain adjacent. Gain the Iapetus Helm [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 290)! If you already have it, gain the Blackmask Rare resource instead.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_003.jpg.text: 对攻击者执行标志行为。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_003.jpg.en: Wound: Perform Signature against the Attacker.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_003.jpg.text: 重击的金属嘶鸣震荡耳膜，可这倾城一击，竟只剥落下赫菲斯吨神甲的一块微小残片。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_003.jpg.en: Critical: The clangor of the strike resounds in your ears and yet you only managed to chip a part of the armor.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_003.jpg.text: 获得 1 份稀有资源「不死银」！

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_004.jpg.en: Fail: Knockdown. Knockback 10 to the left.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_004.jpg.text: 对攻击者执行标志行为。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_004.jpg.en: Wound: Perform Signature against the Attacker.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_004.jpg.text: 这足以开山断岳的劈砍，竟被这神铸合金毫发无损地悍然震开！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_004.jpg.en: Critical: The strike bounces harmlessly off the alloyed armor!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_005.jpg.en: Fail: Knockdown. Knockback 10 to the left.
Wound: [!] Knockback 7 to the left. Pain 1.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_005.jpg.text: 你那开山裂石的一击死死咬住泰坦脊背，刹那间你以为神明将倾，然而它却如流水般以极其优雅的前翻，卸去了这灭顶之灾。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_005.jpg.en: Critical: Your hit connects with the Titan's back, and for a moment you think they're going to fall down, but instead they gracefully roll forward.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_005.jpg.text: 另一架泰坦可以执行一次移动行动。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_005.jpg.en: Another Titan may perform a [Move Action].

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_006.jpg.en: Instinct: Knockback 7 to the left. Pain 1.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_006.jpg.text: 泰坦X横起护腕险险架住怒斩，却也因反震空门大开，为你接踵而至的夺命连环暴露了致命死穴！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_006.jpg.en: Critical: Titan X parries your blow with the bracer, opening themselves up for a follow-up!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_006.jpg.text: 你可以执行一次额外攻击！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_006.jpg.en: You may perform a Bonus Attack!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_007.jpg.text: 对攻击者执行标志行为。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_007.jpg.en: Fail: Perform Signature against the Attacker.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_007.jpg.text: 虽未能贯穿这赫菲斯吨护胫，但那霸道暗劲必已震碎其胫骨，只见泰坦X如风之躯竟肉眼可见地迟缓沉重。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_007.jpg.en: Critical: Your strike does not break the shin armor, but it must've cracked the tibia bone, because Titan X becomes visibly slower.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_007.jpg.text: 泰坦 X 执行瞬步时，越过目标后移动的格数减少 2 格。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_I_007.jpg.en: Reduce the amount of spaces Titan X moves past its Target during Flash Step by 2.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_001.jpg.text: 你废黜了泰坦那双妖异战靴，这诅咒之物，似凭秘法将它这如山魔躯，死死锁定于幽水之下的硬光渊底。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_001.jpg.en: Critical: You damage the strange boots of the Titan, which somehow connect him to the hardlight surface just beneath the waterline.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_001.jpg.text: 泰坦 X 执行瞬步时，越过目标后移动的格数减少 2 格。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_001.jpg.en: Reduce the amount of spaces Titan X moves past its Target during Flash Step by 2.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_002.jpg.text: 对攻击者执行标志行为。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_002.jpg.en: Wound: Perform Signature against the Attacker.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_002.jpg.text: 你铁拳怒砸向疑似深藏密码箱的逆鳞，虽非中枢，却碾碎了某块暗骨。恍惚刹那，你的脑海竟浮现出，那凡人妄凭血肉此般发起神战的悲凉幻世。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_002.jpg.en: Critical: You strike where you suspect the cryptex is hidden, and smash something, though it wasn't it. For a moment, you imagine a world where this is how mortals wage their wars.
Disable the Critical Strikes Trait. Disable the Toying Trait.
Disable the Critical Strikes Trait. Disable the Toying Trait.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 痛苦 2。泰坦 X 不转向，沿直线远离攻击者 9 格。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Wound: Pain 2. Titan X moves 9 spaces directly away from the Attacker without turning.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 你震碎泰坦的装甲项圈，那坚壁竟在瞬间，离奇消融为一滩银色活水！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Critical: You break the Titan's armor collar, and it momentarily turns into silver liquid!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_003.jpg.text: 获得「协同盔甲」装备卡（秘密卡组 18，第 289 张）。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_003.jpg.en: Gain the Synergic Armor [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 289).

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 对攻击者执行标志行为。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_005.jpg.en: Wound: Perform Signature against the Attacker.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 刃锋毒蛇般咬穿泰坦铁甲上的一处暴露死穴，这尊神魔竟惨烈地痛呼踉跄！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_005.jpg.en: Critical: You hit one of the exposed joints of the Titan's armor, and it staggers!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_005.jpg.text: 将泰坦 X 向正后方移动 3 格，然后你向前移动 3 格，保持相邻。另一架泰坦可以立即执行一次移动行动。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_005.jpg.en: Move Titan X 3 spaces directly backwards, then move 3 spaces forward to remain adjacent. Another Titan may immediately perform a [Move Action].

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_006.jpg.text: 痛苦 3。泰坦 X 不转向，沿直线远离攻击者 9 格。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_006.jpg.en: Wound: Pain 3. Titan X moves 9 spaces directly away from the Attacker without turning.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_006.jpg.text: 你斩断了屏蔽敌方痛觉的神经链！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_006.jpg.en: Critical: You destroy the wiring responsible for suppressing your enemy's pain responses!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_006.jpg.text: 弃置每架泰坦的所有痛苦指示物！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_006.jpg.en: Discard all Pain tokens from each Titan!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_007.jpg.text: 利刃贯穿泰坦面甲，生生斩断了那刺目的X形目镜。然这神罚降下，却似未能绊阻它的杀戮狂舞，至少肉眼无法窥探其破绽。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_007.jpg.en: Critical: You connect with the Titan's faceplace, breaking off a part of its impressive X-shaped visor. Yet, it does not hinder it, at least in any visible way.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_007.jpg.text: 直到战斗结束，泰坦 X 在遭受从盲点格发起的攻击时，AT −1。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_II_007.jpg.en: Until the end of Battle, when attacked from the Blindspot space, Titan X has -1 [AT].

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 这一击必是碾断了核枢子系统，泰坦轰然跌跪，其曾经若惊雷般的极速亦变得如生锈齿轮般迟钝僵死。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Critical: You must have damaged a crucial subsystem, because the Titan stumbles and their responses become sluggish, predictable.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_001.jpg.text: 泰坦 X 执行瞬步时，将越过目标后移动的格数减至 0。禁用「玩弄」特质。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_001.jpg.en: Reduce the amount of spaces Titan X moves past its Target during Flash Step to 0. Disable the Toying Trait.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 抽取并结算一张 AI 卡。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_002.jpg.en: Wound: Draw and perform an AI card.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 你贯穿了那枚不断编织虚空六边形立足点的硬光阵眼，它在炽烈如盲目的纯白神闪中崩灭，贪婪吞噬万物。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_002.jpg.en: Critical: You strike the Hardlight Generator that has continuously generated the hexagonal floor beneath you, and it explodes in a bright white flash, consuming all.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_002.jpg.text: 标记 X1。泰坦 X 和所有剩余泰坦死亡！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_002.jpg.en: Mark X1. Titan X and all remaining Titans die!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 抽取并结算一张 AI 卡。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Wound: Draw and perform an AI card.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 你自腕骨上方生生削落泰坦巨掌，魔刃坠地，竟化作诡异半透凝胶。恍惚间你大悟——泰坦正贪婪汲取盔甲它处的流体山铜，令这妖邪之握如死灰复燃般再度重塑。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Critical: You sever the Titan's hand, just above the wrist, and the blade falls to the ground, suddenly gelatinous and translucent. It takes you a moment to realize the hand was generated in the same way – the titan regrows it out of liquid orichalcum drawn from other parts of the armor.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_003.jpg.text: 获得「偷来的刀刃」装备卡（秘密卡组 18，第 288 张）！禁用「破坏趣味」特质。禁用「玩弄」特质。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_003.jpg.en: Gain the Pilfered Blade [Gear] card (Secret deck 18, card 288)! Disable the Killjoy Trait. Disable the Toying Trait.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_004.jpg.text: 禁用「玩弄」特质。对攻击者执行标志行为。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_004.jpg.en: Instinct: Disable the Toying Trait. Perform Signature against the Attacker.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_004.jpg.text: 你狂暴猛击那加固的密码箱，却无法在其如渊般厚重的赫菲斯吨装甲上，凿出哪怕一丝浅薄的白痕。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_004.jpg.en: Critical: You strike at the reinforced cryptex, barely making a dent in its thick hephaestum armor.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_004.jpg.text: 永久获得 +1 蛮力（每位阿尔戈英雄一生限一次）。战斗结束后，结算「恶魔」特殊事件。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_004.jpg.en: Permanently gain +1 Fury (once per Argonaut Lifetime). After the Battle, resolve The Devil Special Event.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_005.jpg.text: 绝杀降临，你已彻底绞烂这尊泰坦的心脏……可这死尸竟依旧挥舞着屠刀。理智的崩塌令你陷入绝望：这怎么可能！
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_005.jpg.en: Critical: You manage to deal a killing blow, pierce or crush the Titan's heart... and it keeps going. You don't know how this is possible!

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_005.jpg.text: 禁用「痛苦 X」关键词。禁用「玩弄」特质。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_005.jpg.en: Disable the Pain X keyword. Disable the Toying Trait.

ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_006.jpg.text: 暴击震碎泰坦X秘藏抗力制御秘卷的暗格！神明威仪荡然无存，其步伐与杀戮摒弃了昔日繁复，彻底沦入嗜血野兽般的狂暴原始。
ps/TITAN_X/TITAN_X_BP_III_006.jpg.en: Critical: You manage to crush Titan X's antikratos scrolls compartment! The titan loses its composure; its moves and attacks become less sophisticated, more primal.

ps/HERMESIAN_PURSUER/HERMESIAN_PURSUER_T.text: 与赫尔墨斯追踪者相邻的泰坦获得「恐惧」状态卡。
ps/HERMESIAN_PURSUER/HERMESIAN_PURSUER_T.sourceText: 当泰坦与赫尔墨斯追击者相邻时，获得状态卡牌畏惧。
ps/HERMESIAN_PURSUER/HERMESIAN_PURSUER_T.en: Titans adjacent to the Hermesian Pursuer gain the Fear Condition card.

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 难以推动的巨石（参见卡）
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 难以推动的巨石（参见卡牌）

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 将图示标出的红色悬崖视作具有「无边限」的版边。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 将图示上标注的红色悬崖视为无垠板图边界。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: Treat the red cliffs marked on the diagram as Boundless Board Edges.

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 战斗开始：将时光前线板块放在编号最小的第 1 列。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 战斗开始：将时间锋板块放置到数字最小的列（1）。

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 泰坦非自愿移动时可以超出拴绳限制。泰坦只要超出拴绳限制，就将所有格子视作沟壑，直到它回到拴绳限制内。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 泰坦非主动移动时可以超出拴绳限制。如果任何时候，泰坦超出拴绳限制，则在回到限制之内之前，将所有格子视为裂谷。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: Titans may move beyond their tether during involuntary movement. While outside their tether, Titans treat all spaces as Chasm until they return within the tether.

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 将时光前线朝上（编号最大的列）移动 3 格。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 将时间锋朝上（数字最高的列）移动3格。

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 如果时光前线移动到泰坦所在格，则将该泰坦从现实中抹除。如果时光前线移动到地形板块上，则摧毁该板块，除非该板块不可摧毁。当时光前线将要移入始徒所在格时，将始徒朝正好远离时光前线的方向移动，让时光前线完成移动。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 如果时间锋移动到泰坦所在格，则将该泰坦从现实中抹除。如果时间锋移动到地形板块上，则除非该板块不毁，否则摧毁该板块。当时间锋将要移动到骇物所在格时，将骇物朝径直远离时间锋的方向移动，使得时间锋移动完整格数。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: Erase a Titan from reality if the Timefront moves into its space. Destroy any destructible Terrain tile the Timefront moves onto. If the Timefront would enter the Primordial’s space, move the Primordial directly away so the Timefront can complete its move.

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 白雪溜冰团、结束的开始
从创伤卡组移除所有正面创伤卡（硬币卡除外）。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 将所有正面效果创伤卡牌从（除生死关头以外的）创伤牌库中移除。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 禁止将滑溜板块视作同一块板块的能力。若始徒轮或你的泰坦回合结束时，你仍在滑溜格上，则朝编号最小的一列移动，直到离开滑溜格。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 禁用所有将湿滑板块视为同一块板块的能力。如果骇物轮次或你泰坦回合结束时，你停留在湿滑格上，则朝数字最小的列移动，直到你不在湿滑格上。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: Disable abilities that treat Slippery tiles as one tile. If you are in a Slippery space at the end of the Primordial Round or your Titan Turn, move toward the lowest numbered column until you leave the Slippery space.

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 始徒轮结束时，重担执行回生。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 骇物轮次结束：巨石执行治疗。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: End of Primordial Round: The Burden performs Heal.

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 额外设置：变更战斗图示，查看规则书「忆识战斗图示」。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 额外设置：变更战斗图示，查看规则书“幻忆战斗图示”。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: Additional Setup: Change the battle diagram. See Mnestis Battle Diagrams in the rulebook.

ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.text: 始徒轮结束：在希望断绝前，另抽取并执行一张 AI 卡。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.sourceText: 骇物轮次结束：在希望终结之前，抽取并执行另一张指令技卡牌。
ps/THE_BURDEN/THE_BURDEN_TR_II_001.jpg.en: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
Add 3 to all Kickbacks performed by the Burden.
